compiled_state.title: debug-everything ci-pr mode sub-branch PRs get zero LLM review after per-branch-review.yml deletion
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description
plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md lines 35, 733, 736, 759, 826 document that ci-pr-mode bug-batch PRs targeting SESSION_BRANCH are reviewed by per-branch-review.yml. That workflow was deleted in commit 4b18d2d644 (story 20d7-09d6). ci.yml's llm-review job is gated to base_ref==main, so bug-batch sub-branch PRs now trigger zero LLM review in ci-pr mode.

## Impact
P1 — silent review bypass for debug-everything ci-pr mode. Users in this mode get no LLM review on sub-branch PRs.

## Root Cause
Story 20d7-09d6 scoped its DDs narrowly to PR-to-main flow. Sub-branch review path (debug-everything ci-pr mode) was not in scope.

## Fix Options
(a) Deprecate ci-pr mode in debug-everything and remove sub-branch review documentation
(b) Restore a sub-branch-targeting review workflow (or adapt ci.yml to also fire on sub-branch PRs targeting the session branch)

## Found By
completion-verifier during story 20d7-09d6 closure (consumer smoke test)
